research.notes: I could not identify the organization behind "Code High School". The agenda gives no city. Searches returned only unrelated results, including a Christian boarding school's Facebook page that is probably not in the US, other coding nonprofits, and OUSD's own schools. I found no registry entry (ProPublica, California Secretary of State, SAM.gov) or website tying a "Code High School" to Oakland, to OUSD, or to the Measure N/H Sojourner Truth Independent Study budget item. I did not guess, to avoid publishing a wrong website or phone number.
